fields.name: TextWarning
documentation: Color to be used when an encounter event shown as a text warning alert.

fields.name: TimelineEvent
documentation: Color to be used when an encounter event is placed on the timeline.

fields.name: TimelineEventHighlight
documentation: Color to be used when an encounter event reaches its 'highlight' duration on the timeline (typically, ~5s before the cast is due).

fields.name: OnTextWarningShown
documentation: Trigger to be activated when an text warning is initially shown for an encounter event.

fields.name: OnTimelineEventFinished
documentation: Trigger to be activated when an encounter event on the timeline transitions to a finished (ie. casted, or resolved) state.

fields.name: OnTimelineEventHighlight
documentation: Trigger to be activated when an encounter event reaches its 'highlight' duration on the timeline (typically, ~5s before the cast is due).

fields.name: encounterEventID
documentation: ID of the encounter event record.

fields.name: enabled
documentation: If true, this event should be displayed on boss ability HUD elements.

fields.name: spellID
documentation: Spell ID that triggers this event. A single spell may be used by multiple encounter events.

fields.name: iconFileID
documentation: Icon file ID for the event. Typically the same as the spell icon, but may be overridden.

fields.name: icons
documentation: Bitmask of spell support icons to show for this event.

fields.name: file
documentation: Sound file to be played when triggered.

fields.name: channel
documentation: Sound channel to play this file on.

fields.name: volume
documentation: Volume scalar for the sound file.
